 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2fb95946.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Move the non-background object toward the full-width separator, then
    # mark its far edge with color 8.
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    full = [r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not full:
        return g
    sep = full[0]
    sep_color = g[sep][0]
    # take the non-background, non-separator pixels as the object
    pts = [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, sep_color)]
    if not pts:
        return g
    minr, maxr = min(p[0] for p in pts), max(p[0] for p in pts)
    # relocate the object's bounding box adjacent to the separator, maintaining its shape
    if maxr < sep:
        newmin = sep - 1 - (maxr-minr)
    else:
        newmin = sep + 1
    dr = newmin - minr
    # clear original object and place translated object
    for r,c,col in pts:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for r,c,col in pts:
        g[r+dr][c] = col
    # draw a full row in 8 at the far side of the relocated object if space permits
    newmax = maxr + dr
    marker = newmax + 1 if newmin > sep else newmin - 1
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        g[marker] = [8]*w
    return g
"
